author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use ChatGPT dots to work toward ongoing goals, connect apps, and keep making progress even when your computer is off. In this step-by-step tutorial, I set up a YouTube coach, connect vidIQ, create a growth plan, collaborate using Spaces and Pages, give feedback by voice, and check the next day's results.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
Sponsored by @OpenAI

📚 RESOURCES
- Download ChatGPT: https://www.chatgpt.com/download/
- Features and availability may vary by plan and account.

⌚ TIMESTAMPS
0:00 - Introduction
0:35 - Get started and create a dot
1:32 - Customize your dot
1:55 - Dots vs. chats and scheduled tasks
2:30 - Connect apps and vidIQ
3:21 - Give your dot a goal
4:10 - Review the plan and scheduled updates
5:02 - Collaborate with Spaces and Pages
6:45 - Call your dot and give feedback
7:55 - Check the next day's update
